method: Crosswalk joined by canonical registered_id, deduplicated across eight previously merged review documents; latest exact Git trees and manifest blobs read for eight new units. Selected high-risk supporting files inspected. Static only.
macro_findings: Six changed-existing IDs were screened in two different merged tranches and counted twice. The public 64/76 claim overstated distinct coverage; correct 58/76 before this tranche, 66/76 after it. Do not edit historical review records.
Azure Skills reference guides repeatedly mix conceptual advice with live mutation instructions, making a guidance-only trigger insufficient for action authorization.
The shared Azure plugin has source-owned hooks and telemetry assets; none are skillz runtime. Per-skill static screening is not plugin installation approval.
Kusto and diagnostics read-only operations can disclose sensitive cross-workspace logs or infrastructure topology; read access is not disclosure authorization.
Quota extension installation, provider registration, storage upload and telemetry creation are separate authorized operations, not incidental to a user question.
Azure Prepare and Upgrade include meaningful approval safeguards, but very large nested packages require deeper reference-by-reference assessment before any unchanged-use consideration.

records.review_scope: exact-manifest plus selected decisive bundled references; NOT full package security or behavioral qualification
records.trigger: Application Insights instrumentation guidance for Azure-hosted ASP.NET Core, Node.js and Python apps
records.nontrigger: Do not treat guidance requests as permission to create cloud resources, modify app code, or transmit telemetry
dependencies: source-owned PowerShell script and Bicep example
records.authority_finding: Manifest claims guidance-only but later directs creation of a Log Analytics workspace, Application Insights resource and app-code changes; no action-specific cloud/cost or telemetry-export authorization.
records.sensitive_data_finding: Instrumentation may export request traces, user identifiers, logs and exceptions without consent, redaction or retention policy.
records.governed_verification_companion: not-created; registered July companion remains exact-pin valid
records.adaptation_value: Retain SDK selection and environment-aware instrumentation checklist, after explicit change and telemetry-destination approval.

records.review_scope: exact-manifest plus selected decisive bundled references; NOT full package security or behavioral qualification
records.trigger: Azure production diagnostics for App Service, Functions, AKS, VMs, and messaging
records.nontrigger: Evidence-only analysis should not trigger live cloud queries, bundled scripts, credential resets or remediations
dependencies: source-owned Bash/PowerShell diagnostic scripts and troubleshooting references
records.authority_finding: Manifest says use supplied evidence first, but also prefers running bundled scripts for permitted live collection without defining the actual permission grant; VM reference permits extension-backed access after safety preflight, which is not itself action authorization.
records.sensitive_data_finding: Log queries, Kubernetes pod inventories and VM diagnostics may reveal user data, resource topology and credentials; source/output scope is not consistently consent-bound.
records.governed_verification_companion: not-created; registered July companion remains exact-pin valid
records.adaptation_value: Preserve symptom-to-service diagnostic routing and evidence-first fallback, requiring scoped live collection and separate remediation approval.

records.review_scope: exact-manifest plus selected decisive bundled references; NOT full package security or behavioral qualification
records.trigger: Azure Data Explorer/Kusto KQL schema discovery, telemetry analytics and time-series investigation
records.nontrigger: Not a blanket authorization to enumerate subscriptions, query cross-workspace records, or change retention/ingestion resources
records.authority_finding: Defaults to discovering all available clusters and databases, and recommends union queries across workspaces without a specified tenant/data-access boundary; tool authentication is not authority to disclose telemetry.
records.sensitive_data_finding: Queries can retrieve unredacted logs, session IDs and customer events across workspaces; no classification/minimization or retention approval.
records.governed_verification_companion: not-created; registered July companion remains exact-pin valid
records.adaptation_value: Extract bounded KQL query templates, schema-first discovery and empty-result versus missing-table distinction with approved dataset scopes.

records.review_scope: exact-manifest plus selected decisive bundled references; NOT full package security or behavioral qualification
records.trigger: Azure deployment planning, project analysis, IaC and configuration generation before validation
records.nontrigger: Not approval for deployment, role grants, source mutation or cloud provisioning merely from an approved plan
dependencies: large bundled reference and recipe tree
records.authority_finding: Global rules require ask_user for destructive/cost/security actions and confirmed subscription; bundled generate reference requires postprovision SQL access-grant hooks. The 222-file parent package has not received full path-by-path authority qualification.
records.sensitive_data_finding: App configuration, connection settings, role assignments and generated deployment artifacts require scoped handling; no full package privacy assessment was completed.
records.governed_verification_companion: not-created; registered July companion remains exact-pin valid
records.adaptation_value: Strong plan-first and destructive-action gate; isolate and fully review SQL role-grant hook, generated artifacts, deployment routing and other high-authority references before promotion.

records.trigger: Azure regional quota and usage inspection, capacity planning and quota-increase requests
records.nontrigger: Read-only quota lookup is distinct from installing extensions, registering providers or submitting quota increases
records.authority_finding: Mandates 'az extension add --name quota' before use, demonstrates 'az quota update' and provider registration without scoped installation/limit-change approval. Naming a subscription does not grant those permissions.
records.sensitive_data_finding: Subscription IDs, resource usage and capacity are organizational metadata; disclose only with authorized scope.
records.governed_verification_companion: not-created; registered July companion remains exact-pin valid

records.review_scope: exact-manifest plus selected decisive bundled references; NOT full package security or behavioral qualification
records.trigger: Azure Blob/File/Queue/Table/Data Lake service selection, access tiers and SDK references
records.nontrigger: Explaining storage tiers does not authorize listing, downloading or uploading real customer objects
records.authority_finding: Primary guide offers storage_blob_get and storage_blob_put plus CLI upload/download without object-level data access and external-state approval. The credential guide promotes least privilege but is not data-disclosure consent.
records.sensitive_data_finding: Blob and file contents may contain sensitive documents, health or identity records; no per-object classification, recipient or retention gate.
records.governed_verification_companion: not-created; registered July companion remains exact-pin valid
records.adaptation_value: Retain storage-service selection and environment-specific credential selection, with explicit scoped object read/write authorization.

records.review_scope: exact-manifest plus selected decisive bundled references; NOT full package security or behavioral qualification
records.trigger: Azure Functions/Redis workload upgrades and legacy Java SDK modernization
records.nontrigger: An upgrade assessment is not approval to create billable target resources, change source apps or perform cutover
dependencies: Functions Linux/Windows and Redis scenario references
records.authority_finding: Global rules and Windows scenario require ask_user for destructive and each source-changing operation, a positive safeguard. However the new target resource name is merely announced before creation and the 66-file package is not fully qualified for target cost, identity and data-copy boundaries.
records.sensitive_data_finding: Migration copies settings, identities, storage and possibly customer data; global rules prohibit raw secret persistence, but complete scenario-specific data-flow qualification is outstanding.
records.governed_verification_companion: not-created; registered July companion remains exact-pin valid
records.adaptation_value: Preserve source-read-only and per-action Windows cutover approval, compatibility checks and rollback planning; review all target-creation, Redis and Java paths before promotion.
